Doubt failure se zyada sapne maar deta hai.
Aandhere mein hi aap taare dekh sakte hain.
Jo lagta hai na ho sake, wahi karo.
Dabaav ke beech shaant aur sthir rehna hi asli himmat hai.
Grit matlab chhorna nahi.
Khamoshi taqat ka sabse bada hathiyar hai.
Khamoshi vishal hai.
Khamoshi choose bhi ki ja sakti.
Grit lambe samay ka junoon hai.
Grit ka matlab mushkil cheezon pe kaam.
Himmat dar ka ilaaj hai.
Silence dimaag ki neend hai.
Grit "someday" ko "today" banata.
Grit jazba aur lagaataar mehnat hai.
Jeene ki himmat, dukh ki himmat bhi.
Sirf ek cheez se darna hai, wo khud dar.
Silence sabse powerful scream hai.
Khamoshi power hai.
Courage—vulnerable hone ki willingness se shuru.
Sirf tab bolna jab wo chup ko behtar bana sake.
